issues.title: Verify the port runs on iOS Safari
issues.pin: Gate passed: the port boots on a phone, so the overlay work was worth starting.

issues.title: Touch input layer
issues.pin: The shared state object every touch control writes to. Built before any layout.

issues.title: Gamepad API for Bluetooth pads
issues.pin: A real controller works on a phone, which sidesteps the overlay for anybody who owns one.

issues.title: On-screen control layout
issues.pin: Needs a device in hand. No amount of code decides where a thumb reaches.

issues.title: Accessibility defaults for touch
issues.pin: Wording only. The defaults are chosen; the issue text still argues with itself.

issues.title: Mobile layout: full-viewport canvas
issues.pin: Code complete. Waits on one iPhone screenshot to close.

issues.title: Mobile CSS: pre-Start controls reachable
issues.pin: A check now fails if the Start controls move out of reach.

issues.title: Shared lobby URL with port claiming
issues.pin: The main thread. Signalling, room claims and the data channel all measured working. Last gap: a browser on a second network.

issues.title: TURN relay for symmetric NAT
issues.pin: Blocked on a NAT reading from two real endpoints. This network is cone, so it cannot produce the failing case.

issues.title: Drop-in join: send the whole sim state
issues.pin: A second player joins a match already running. Not started.

issues.title: Allow a CPU adapter behind a switch
issues.pin: aurora refuses a CPU adapter, so no browser check runs headless. Filed, not started.

issues.title: Headless runs can draw on the desktop
issues.pin: Fixed in melee-pc: the display variables are removed inside cage. melee-web still needs the same line.

issues.title: launcher-close-repeat loses the GPU device
issues.pin: Pass 1 destroys the device at teardown, so pass 2 finds no video device. Pre-existing.

issues.title: Optimize the browser build
issues.pin: 18 fps on iOS against an -O1 build. Keep open until the boot trap stays absent across a clean rebuild.

issues.title: Training scenarios from a URL
issues.pin: Partly done. Remaining: objective checks, one link per scenario, custom scenarios.

issues.title: GC adapter called two missing C functions
issues.pin: Two calls into functions that were never defined. Removed.

issues.title: _malloc survived only by accident
issues.pin: Not in EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS. It worked until something else changed.
